description:
An empty materializer response returns before local-write merging and conflict tracking. This breaks read-your-writes and can admit phantom-dependent transactions that should conflict.

Confirmed at `8f962e09` through `RangeReads.get_range/4` with an injected empty storage response and the real transaction encoder. The distributed anomaly below follows from the omitted conflict set; a full-cluster reproduction should be added.

```elixir
alias Bedrock.DataPlane.{Transaction, Version}
alias Bedrock.Internal.TransactionBuilder.{State, Tx, RangeReads}
v = Version.from_integer(100)
s = %State{read_version: v, tx: Tx.set(Tx.new(), "b", "local"),
  routing_fn: fn _ -> {:ok, {"", "z", [self()]}} end}
{s, result} = RangeReads.get_range(s, {"a", "c"}, 10,
  storage_get_range_fn: fn _, _, _, _, _ -> {:ok, {[], false}} end)
IO.inspect(result) # actual {:ok, {[], false}}; expected b=local
IO.inspect(Transaction.decode(Tx.commit(s.tx, v))) # read_conflicts: {nil, []}
```

Run with `MIX_ENV=test mix run --no-start /tmp/repro.exs`.

[lib/bedrock/internal/transaction_builder/range_reads.ex](https://github.com/bedrock-kv/bedrock/blob/8f962e09b24765265eeb6bd818f5b26da8d91b99/lib/bedrock/internal/transaction_builder/range_reads.ex#L97) special-cases `{[], false}` before `Tx.merge_storage_range_with_writes/5`, even though that helper has an empty-storage branch.

Two transactions can both observe the same empty range and each insert a different key based on that absence. With no range read conflicts, both can commit despite an invariant permitting only one insertion.

## Acceptance criteria

- Empty storage still merges all applicable pending writes and clears.
- Ordinary empty reads record the effective half-open read range; snapshot reads honor their conflict policy.
- A public Repo test covers pending put followed by an empty-storage range read.
- Concurrent empty-range conditional inserts into different keys produce the appropriate conflict/retry.
- Cover bounded ranges, empty shards, and pagination.

comments.text: GitHub issue: https://github.com/bedrock-kv/bedrock/issues/235. Published the 2026-09-05 implementation evaluation, pinned to 8f962e09, with evidence and acceptance criteria. Reproduced findings are distinguished from source-level risks. No implementation fix is included.

Red stage: test/bedrock/internal/transaction_builder/range_reads_test.exs has 11 tests/11 failures at cfaab90a. Includes missing local writes, no absence conflicts, real resolver admitting both conditional inserts, ignored snapshot options, pending prefix omission and premature pagination completion on empty/cleared pages. Plan for cold review: /tmp/bedrock-issue-team-20260905/235-plan.md. No implementation edits yet.

Cold plan and final audit approved: /tmp/bedrock-issue-team-20260905/235-final-review.md. Original 13 range regressions failed; fixed range scans expose a second resolver read-range versus point-write hole, separately reproduced and cold-reviewed. Final 21 focused tests green, full 17 doctests/158 properties/2913 tests/0 failures; strict Credo and Dialyzer clean. Public Repo concurrent test uses real builder/encoding/resolver and retry loop with controlled scheduling/storage; full-core harness remains #239. One earlier full run hit MinIO port collision and one timing-sensitive LongPulls test exceeded its 100ms tolerance under compile load; final isolated full run passed. Arbitrary offset selector cross-shard semantics remain bedrock-mi1; canonical range selectors covered.
Draft PR https://github.com/bedrock-kv/bedrock/pull/245 published, commit d8ae2513. Final audit approved and required checks passed; no merge performed.

title: Empty range reads omit pending writes and read-conflict ranges
